international.title: Microsoft outage hits hospitals, GPs, schools and police across UK
international.summary: NHS experiencing ‘serious’ and widespread disruption and people are told of possible delays in receiving prescriptions Microsoft outage – live updates Hospitals, GPs and police forces across the UK have been hit by the global Microsoft outage, as key services battle to get systems back online. Police forces across the country reported that their systems had been affected, while NHS sources said the healthcare system was experiencing “widespread” and “serious” disruption, with staff reporting being unable to access email and IT systems they use to deliver healthcare.
